cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave my collapsed cake where it is. I'll want a photograph of it beside the winning one; the contrast will be magnificent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've burned the oven out. Should I cancel the entry?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Find me a replacement oven. Winning after changing the whole kitchen will be a better story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The competition is tomorrow. The shop can only deliver at midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Book midnight. I'll mix while we wait, and you photograph the delivery time. When that cake arrives at judging, they'll know how little night we had left to make it happen.
